name: directconnect
description: Direct Connect links your internal network to an Direct Connect location over a standard Ethernet fiber-optic cable.

subcommands.name: accept-direct-connect-gateway-association-proposal
subcommands.description: Accepts a proposal request to attach a virtual private gateway or transit gateway to a Direct Connect gateway.

subcommands.name: allocate-connection-on-interconnect
subcommands.description: Deprecated.

subcommands.name: allocate-hosted-connection
subcommands.description: Creates a hosted connection on the specified interconnect or a link aggregation group (LAG) of interconnects.

subcommands.name: allocate-private-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Provisions a private virtual interface to be owned by the specified Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: allocate-public-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Provisions a public virtual interface to be owned by the specified Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: allocate-transit-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Provisions a transit virtual interface to be owned by the specified Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: associate-connection-with-lag
subcommands.description: Associates an existing connection with a link aggregation group (LAG).

subcommands.name: associate-hosted-connection
subcommands.description: Associates a hosted connection and its virtual interfaces with a link aggregation group (LAG) or interconnect.

subcommands.name: associate-mac-sec-key
subcommands.description: Associates a MAC Security (MACsec) Connection Key Name (CKN)/ Connectivity Association Key (CAK) pair with a Direct Connect connection.

subcommands.name: associate-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Associates a virtual interface with a specified link aggregation group (LAG) or connection.

subcommands.name: confirm-connection
subcommands.description: Confirms the creation of the specified hosted connection on an interconnect.

subcommands.name: confirm-customer-agreement
subcommands.description: The confirmation of the terms of agreement when creating the connection/link aggregation group (LAG).

subcommands.name: confirm-private-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Accepts ownership of a private virtual interface created by another Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: confirm-public-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Accepts ownership of a public virtual interface created by another Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: confirm-transit-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Accepts ownership of a transit virtual interface created by another Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-bgp-peer
subcommands.description: Creates a BGP peer on the specified virtual interface.

subcommands.name: create-connection
subcommands.description: Creates a connection between a customer network and a specific Direct Connect location.

subcommands.name: create-direct-connect-gateway
subcommands.description: Creates a Direct Connect gateway, which is an intermediate object that enables you to connect a set of virtual interfaces and virtual private gateways.

subcommands.name: create-direct-connect-gateway-association
subcommands.description: Creates an association between a Direct Connect gateway and a virtual private gateway.

subcommands.name: create-direct-connect-gateway-association-proposal
subcommands.description: Creates a proposal to associate the specified virtual private gateway or transit gateway with the specified Direct Connect gateway.

subcommands.name: create-interconnect
subcommands.description: Creates an interconnect between an Direct Connect Partner's network and a specific Direct Connect location.

subcommands.name: create-lag
subcommands.description: Creates a link aggregation group (LAG) with the specified number of bundled physical dedicated connections between the customer network and a specific Direct Connect location.

subcommands.name: create-private-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Creates a private virtual interface.

subcommands.name: create-public-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Creates a public virtual interface.

subcommands.name: create-transit-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Creates a transit virtual interface.

subcommands.name: delete-bgp-peer
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified BGP peer on the specified virtual interface with the specified customer address and ASN.

subcommands.name: delete-connection
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified connection.

subcommands.name: delete-direct-connect-gateway
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified Direct Connect gateway.

subcommands.name: delete-direct-connect-gateway-association
subcommands.description: Deletes the association between the specified Direct Connect gateway and virtual private gateway.

subcommands.name: delete-direct-connect-gateway-association-proposal
subcommands.description: Deletes the association proposal request between the specified Direct Connect gateway and virtual private gateway or transit gateway.

subcommands.name: delete-interconnect
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified interconnect.

subcommands.name: delete-lag
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified link aggregation group (LAG).

subcommands.name: delete-virtual-interface
subcommands.description: Deletes a virtual interface.

subcommands.name: describe-connection-loa
subcommands.description: Deprecated.

subcommands.name: describe-connections
subcommands.description: Displays the specified connection or all connections in this Region.

subcommands.name: describe-connections-on-interconnect
subcommands.description: Deprecated.

subcommands.name: describe-customer-metadata
subcommands.description: Get and view a list of customer agreements, along with their signed status and whether the customer is an NNIPartner, NNIPartnerV2, or a nonPartner.

subcommands.name: describe-direct-connect-gateway-association-proposals
subcommands.description: Describes one or more association proposals for connection between a virtual private gateway or transit gateway and a Direct Connect gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-direct-connect-gateway-associations
subcommands.description: Lists the associations between your Direct Connect gateways and virtual private gateways and transit gateways.

subcommands.name: describe-direct-connect-gateway-attachments
subcommands.description: Lists the attachments between your Direct Connect gateways and virtual interfaces.

subcommands.name: describe-direct-connect-gateways
subcommands.description: Lists all your Direct Connect gateways or only the specified Direct Connect gateway.

subcommands.name: describe-hosted-connections
subcommands.description: Lists the hosted connections that have been provisioned on the specified interconnect or link aggregation group (LAG).

subcommands.name: describe-interconnect-loa
subcommands.description: Deprecated.

subcommands.name: describe-interconnects
subcommands.description: Lists the interconnects owned by the Amazon Web Services account or only the specified interconnect.

subcommands.name: describe-lags
subcommands.description: Describes all your link aggregation groups (LAG) or the specified LAG.

subcommands.name: describe-loa
subcommands.description: Gets the LOA-CFA for a connection, interconnect, or link aggregation group (LAG).

subcommands.name: describe-locations
subcommands.description: Lists the Direct Connect locations in the current Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: describe-router-configuration
subcommands.description: Details about the router.

subcommands.name: describe-tags
subcommands.description: Describes the tags associated with the specified Direct Connect resources.

subcommands.name: describe-virtual-gateways
subcommands.description: Deprecated.

subcommands.name: describe-virtual-interfaces
subcommands.description: Displays all virtual interfaces for an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: disassociate-connection-from-lag
subcommands.description: Disassociates a connection from a link aggregation group (LAG).

subcommands.name: disassociate-mac-sec-key
subcommands.description: Removes the association between a MAC Security (MACsec) security key and a Direct Connect connection.

subcommands.name: list-virtual-interface-test-history
subcommands.description: Lists the virtual interface failover test history.

subcommands.name: start-bgp-failover-test
subcommands.description: Starts the virtual interface failover test that verifies your configuration meets your resiliency requirements by placing the BGP peering session in the DOWN state.

subcommands.name: stop-bgp-failover-test
subcommands.description: Stops the virtual interface failover test.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds the specified tags to the specified Direct Connect resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified Direct Connect resource.

subcommands.name: update-connection
subcommands.description: Updates the Direct Connect connection configuration.

subcommands.name: update-direct-connect-gateway
subcommands.description: Updates the name of a current Direct Connect gateway.

subcommands.name: update-direct-connect-gateway-association
subcommands.description: Updates the specified attributes of the Direct Connect gateway association.

subcommands.name: update-lag
subcommands.description: Updates the attributes of the specified link aggregation group (LAG).

subcommands.name: update-virtual-interface-attributes
subcommands.description: Updates the specified attributes of the specified virtual private interface.
